Projects.title: Au Nord des Rails
Projects.description: Evolutive visual identity for indie brewers Au Nord des Rails. The designs followed the very nature of the project: trying out different things, following disparate ideas and seeing what we end up with. The labels have covered bottles of beer, cider and wine throughout the years.
Projects.label: Natural identities

Projects.title: Les acacias de l’Ampolla
Projects.description: This project is a visual essay on rememberance. It is split in three books, each representing a different state of a memory (figurative, suggestive, abstract). The images were generated by a GAN, using family holidays archives as a dataset. Poetry and drawing complete the visuals to illustrate the decay of representation in memories and the abstraction which results over time. The revelance of A.I. generated images are thus critically questioned.
Projects.label: Hallucinated memories
Projects.technical: InDesign, Runway ML GAN, Photoshop, Inkjet + Laser printing

Projects.title: Fondation Pierre Gianadda
Projects.description: This redesign proposal focuses on the navigation experience. Elements of the fondation’s building are used throughout for this matter, with the main entrances symbolising the different parts of the website. Thematic colours are used to help keep track of where one is in the website, and are used as highlights for the interactive elements. It offers a simple experience, so that visitors can focus on the exceptional content of the fondation’s diverse proposals.
Projects.label: Architecturally

Projects.title: Rume Penolu
Projects.description: A poster on the writings of Elicura Chihuailaf. His work had been selected as part of the Paisajes Poéticos de Chile project. The poster symbolises an identity carrying through the veil imposed by colonialism, political repression and systemic racism. It has been selected to be displayed permanently at the Suizpacio in Santiago de Chile, the cultural space of the Swiss embassy.
Projects.label: Xerox poetry

Projects.title: Crowlista
Projects.label: Alba bound
Projects.description:
This typeface draws inspiration from the ionic canon (think Clarendon). Its rhythm is based on an obscure version of Antiques, with very wide capitals as well as selected lowercase characters. The approach of the serif is quite generous so that the font keeps an inviting, warm feel despite its rectangular serifs.
First image: Poetics of Resistance website by Stavros Gialamidis

This book materialises the social dynamics of the film HER’s protagonists using spatial layout and hierarchies to outline egocentrism, loneliness and loss. The central columns, set in big type, are Joaquin Pheonix’s character lines, while the side columns contain his partner’s text, treated like side notes. Each section has the scene’s prominent tone as ink colour.
Projects.label: Digital love

Projects.title: Yours to Play and Win
Projects.description: BA diploma project involved the creation and communication of the Crowlista Mono typeface. The glyphs are interactive both physically, with a wooden chess set, and digitally, with a website. It refers to Duchamp’s conception of chess pieces as the « block alphabet which shapes thoughts ».
Projects.label: Merci Marcel
Projects.technical: Glyphs App, Indesign, Woodworking, Digital printing, HTML/CSS/JavaScript

Projects.title: ad hoc.
Projects.description: This magazine was produced with Stavros Gialamidis in 2021. It focused on artistic spaces, whether they were about exhibitions or practice. It contained interviews of Yves Dana, Alexandru Balgiù and Eliot Möwes, as well as a visual essay by Louis Victorin Michel and in-house texts and images.
Projects.label: In other words
Projects.technical: InDesign, Interviews, Editorial direction, Copywriting, Digital printing

Projects.title: Rectify
Projects.description: Rectify is a prototype of a record store tool that provides the visitors with intentionnally incomplete information about their record selection. Tracks snippets, short description, credits. Just enough to know a little, without giving away the pleasure of finding out when unpacking the vinyl. It was made in collaboration with Rishab Sachidanand.
Projects.label: A digger’s quest

Projects.title: Reckoner
Projects.description: Reckoner is a note taking and comparison tool. It is a vocal-driven software working on mobile with barely any UI. It accompanies or replaces on-paper annotations and lets the reader speak their mind as they’re reading while minimising the digital presence and distractions. It removes the manual transcription step to build a digital collection of annotations and uses cross-referencing to suggest links between the existing notes upon processing.
Projects.label: Look ma, no hands ÷)
